items_all.title: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context
items_all.summary: Z.ai has released GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series — a 320B-total / 18B-active MoE with a 1,048,576-token context window, MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face, and API pricing at $0.15/M input and $0.50/M output. It scores 84.3 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 63.4 on DeepSWE v1.1, using hybrid KDA linear plus NoPE sparse MLA attention to cut attention compute ~3× and KV cache 4.4× versus GLM-5.3. The post Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 智譜 發布了 GLM-5.3-Flash，這是 GLM-5 系列中首個原生多模態模型。該模型擁有 3,200 億總資料量和 180 億活動資料量，上下文視窗大小為 1,048,576 個 Token，權重採用 MIT 許可，API 定價為每百萬輸入 0.15 美元，每百萬輸出 0.50 美元。 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 測試中獲得 84.3 分，在 DeepSWE v1.1 測試中獲得 63.4 分。它採用混合 KDA 線性注意力機制和 NoPE 稀疏 MLA 注意力機制，相較於 GLM-5.3，注意力計算量降低了約 3 倍，鍵值快取降低了 4.4 倍。這篇文章《智譜 發布 GLM-5.3-Flash：一款擁有 100 萬個 Token 上下文的 320 億-180 億原生多模態模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。 Hugging Face

items_all.title: Alibaba’s Qwen Team Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A 125B Multimodal MoE With 6B Active Parameters Previewing the Qwen4 Architecture
items_all.summary: We look at Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Alibaba's open-weight multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model and an early preview of the Qwen4 architecture. We break down where the 180B parameters actually sit: a 125B backbone, a 51B N-gram embedding table, and a 4B multi-token prediction module, with only 6B active per token. We walk through the four architectural changes — the Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention hybrid, Gated Residual, N-gram Embedding, and the Muon optimizer. We also cover the benchmark results, the reported 1/9 training cost against Qwen3.7-Plus, and what self-hosting a 172.78 GiB FP8 checkpoint really demands. The post Alibaba’s Qwen Team Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A 125B Multimodal MoE With 6B Active Parameters Previewing the Qwen4 Architecture appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 本文將介紹 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、阿里巴巴的 開放權重多模態專家混合模型以及 Qwen4 架構的早期預覽版。我們將詳細分析 1800 億參數的實際分佈：一個 1250 億的骨幹網路、一個 510 億的 N-gram 嵌入表和一個 40 億的多標記預測模組，其中每個標記僅需 60 億個有效參數。我們將詳細介紹四項架構變更—閘控 DeltaNet 和 Qwen 稀疏注意力混合模型、門控殘差、N-gram 嵌入以及 Muon 優化器。此外，我們還將介紹基準測試結果、Qwen4 相對於 Qwen3.7-Plus 的 1/9 訓練成本，以及自架 172.78 GiB FP8 檢查點所需的實際資源。文章「阿里巴巴的 Qwen 團隊發布 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：一款具有 60 億個活動參數的 125B 多模 MoE，預覽 Qwen4 架構」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Alibaba releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, targeting "ultimate cost efficiency"
items_all.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team is previewing the Qwen4 architecture with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a mixture-of-experts model that activates just 6 out of 125 billion parameters per token. At one-ninth the training cost, it beats much larger competitors like DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Claude Opus 4.6 on coding and office benchmarks, adding more pricing pressure on OpenAI and Anthropic. The article Alibaba releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, targeting "ultimate cost efficiency" appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴的 和 Qwen 團隊正在預覽 Qwen4 架構，並推出了 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 模型。模型採用混合專家模型，每個 token 僅活化 1,250 億個參數中的 6 個。其訓練成本僅為同類產品的九分之一，在編碼和辦公室基準測試中均優於 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 Claude Opus 4.6 等規模更大的競爭對手，這無疑給 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 帶來了更大的價格壓力。文章《阿里巴巴 發布 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，目標「極致成本效益」》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: Orchestration is the new challenge for CX in the age of AI agents
items_all.summary: Presented by Tata Communications Enterprises are deploying AI agents, voice AI, and automation across messaging, voice, and digital channels faster than the architecture meant to support it. Most of that deployment has involved attaching conversational AI to legacy systems never built for it, says Gaurav Anand, global head of the Customer Interaction Suite at Tata Communications. "In the rush to deploy AI, organizations have largely bolted conversational AI onto legacy systems," Anand says. "As a result, while many enterprises have adopted digital tools, very few have platforms that are truly integrated, scaled, and capable of seamless orchestration." That gap creates a heavy cognitive load for human agents who must piece together context across disjointed tools to understand what an AI system has already told a customer. The challenge is not simply access to data, but the absence of a shared enterprise context that connects customer identities, interactions, transactions, policies, journeys, and operational systems into a common understanding. Traditional CX architecture was built for linear, human-driven routing, not for managing real-time data flows between autonomous AI systems, data lakes, and human workers. "Today's operational complexity is no longer about adding more intelligence," he adds. "It is about coordinating the existing intelligence across the enterprise, so the enterprise customer never feels the friction of those internal silos. That requires a shared context layer that allows AI systems, applications, and people to operate from the same understanding of
items_all.summary_zh: 塔塔通訊公司指出，企業在訊息、語音和數位管道部署人工智慧代理、語音人工智慧和自動化的速度已經超過了其架構本身的承載能力。塔塔通訊公司客戶互動套件全球負責人高拉夫·阿南德表示，大多數部署都是將對話式人工智慧附加到原本並未為此設計的舊系統上。 「在匆忙部署人工智慧的過程中，企業大多隻是將對話式人工智慧生硬地附加到舊系統上，」阿南德說道，「因此，儘管許多企業已經採用了數位化工具，但真正擁有整合、可擴充套件且能夠無縫協調的平臺的企業卻寥寥無幾。」這種差距給人工客服帶來了沉重的認知負擔，他們必須從分散的客戶中理解挑戰不僅在於資料訪問，還在於缺乏一個能夠將客戶身份、互動、交易、策略、旅程和營運系統連線起來的共享企業上下文。傳統的客戶體驗架構是為線性、人工驅動的路由而設計的，而不是為了管理自主人工智慧系統、資料湖和人工客服之間的即時資料流。他補充說：“如今的運營複雜性不再在於增加更多智慧，而在於協調企業內部現有的智慧，從而避免企業客戶感受到內部資訊孤島帶來的摩擦。這需要一個共享的上下文層，使人工智慧係統、應用程式和人員能夠基於相同的理解開展工作。”

items_all.title: Bill Gates warns AI is more dangerous than the tech industry will admit
items_all.summary: Bill Gates warns in an essay and an NYT interview about mass unemployment and easier bioterrorism through AI, and he accuses his own industry of deliberately hiding the risks. "It's bad for us, for the next trillion we're trying to raise." He rejects self-regulation and instead calls for institutions modeled on nuclear weapons control and a token tax on AI use. The article Bill Gates warns AI is more dangerous than the tech industry will admit appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 比爾蓋茲在一篇文章和接受《紐約時報》採訪時警告說，人工智慧可能導致大規模失業，並使生物恐怖主義更容易發生，他還指責科技業故意隱瞞這些風險。 「這對我們不利，不利於我們努力籌集的下一個萬億美元。」他反對自我監管，而是呼籲建立類似核武管制的機構，並對人工智慧的使用徵收象徵性稅。這篇文章《比爾蓋茲警告：人工智慧比科技業承認的更危險》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all.title: IBM drops open-weight Granite 4.2 family with built-in agentic capabilities under Apache 2.0
items_all.summary: IBM is releasing its Granite 4.2 language models in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes, trained on about 15 trillion tokens with a context window of up to 512,000 tokens. The larger models use "agentic RL" training to learn tool use and code execution on their own. All models are available under the Apache 2.0 license. The article IBM drops open-weight Granite 4.2 family with built-in agentic capabilities under Apache 2.0 appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: IBM 發布了其 Granite 4.2 語言模型，規模分別為 30 億、80 億和 300 億，這些模型使用約 15 兆個詞元進行訓練，上下文視窗最大可達 51.2 萬個詞元。規模較大的模型採用「智能體強化學習 (agentic RL)」訓練，能夠自主學習工具使用和程式碼執行。所有模型均以 Apache 2.0 授權發布。文章《IBM 發佈內建智慧體功能的開源 Granite 4.2 系列，採用 Apache 2.0 授權》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: Gartner示警AI可從既有資料推論敏感個人資訊，成隱私管理新風險
items_all.summary: 商業與科技研究機構Gartner預測，到了2029年，多數隱私事件將不再源自個人識別資訊直接曝光，而是AI根據既有資料產生的個人資訊推論所引發的風險。即使資料本身看似無害，或已經過匿名化、彙整處理，AI仍可能綜合其中線索，推論出健康狀況、行為模式等敏感個人資訊。

items_all.title: OpenAI自研推論晶片Jalapeño首批實測出爐，挑戰Nvidia GB200與GB300
items_all.summary: OpenAI公佈首款自研推論晶片Jalapeño的首批效能測試結果，在GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek R1 670B與Kimi K2.5 1T三款大型語言模型上，Jalapeño峰值每瓦吞吐量為比較系統的1.5至1.9倍，端到端回應延遲則減少約43%至72%。OpenAI預計2026年底開始將Jalapeño部署到自家運算基礎架構。

items_all.title: 數發部將建立政府AI風險評估機制，未來政府大型AI服務上線前擬納入風險審查、10月公佈機關AI內控範本
items_all.summary: 隨著「人工智慧基本法」在今年1月14日正式施行，推動政府數位轉型及AI治理的數發部已規畫建立政府機關的AI治理制度。數發部數位政府司長王誠明在今天(8/26)的數位政府高峰會中表示，政府AI應用已從試驗階段逐步進入制度化管理，未來將建立一套標準化的AI風險評估與內控制度，讓各機關在匯入生成式AI及AI代理（AI Agent）等新技術時，有一致的治理流程可遵循。 王誠明首先指出，近年生成式AI快速普及，許多公務人員已開始主動嘗試各種AI工具，政府當務之急是要建立「如何安全使用AI」的治理制度。他形容，目前AI發展就像高速公路剛開始有大量車輛上路，「良好的治理不是限制你的手腳，而是讓創新可以放心往前走」，他說。

items_all.title: IBM Releases Granite 4.2: Bringing Native Reasoning and Agentic RL to Open Enterprise Models
items_all.summary: IBM has released Granite 4.2, a family of open reasoning language models in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes, all under Apache 2.0. Every model exposes a thinking / low-effort / non-thinking switch and native tool calling. The 8B and 30B additionally go through an agentic RL block that trains them to edit code, drive a terminal, and run web searches inside real sandboxed environments. The 30B reports 57.00 on SWE-Bench Verified and 29.24 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. The post IBM Releases Granite 4.2: Bringing Native Reasoning and Agentic RL to Open Enterprise Models appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: IBM 發布了 Granite 4.2，這是一系列開放推理語言模型，包含 3B、8B 和 30B 三種規模，均採用 Apache 2.0 授權。每個模型都提供「思考/低投入/非思考」切換開關和原生工具呼叫。 8B 和 30B 模型也經過一個智慧強化學習模組，該模組訓練它們在真實的沙盒環境中編輯程式碼、操作終端和進行網路搜尋。 30B 模型在 SWE-Bench Verified 測試中獲得 57.00 分，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 測試中獲得 29.24 分。本文《IBM 發布 Granite 4.2：將原生推理與智慧強化學習引入開放企業模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Quoting Paul Dix
items_all.summary: The fact that AI wrote 1M LOC and then refined it over the course of the next couple of months to produce a reliable piece of software that is currently running on millions of developer machines is absolutely mind blowing. And you can say, “well it’s not that impressive because they had an oracle to compare against, so it was simple to go from one language to another”, but I think that’s selling this entire thing short. If you can build a verification system and give proper direction, AI can produce a highly complex, highly sophisticated piece of software and it can continue to refine it until it just works. — Paul Dix , The end of programming Tags: coding-agents , ai-assisted-programming , generative-ai , bun , ai , llms

items_all_raw.title: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context
items_all_raw.summary: Z.ai has released GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series — a 320B-total / 18B-active MoE with a 1,048,576-token context window, MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face, and API pricing at $0.15/M input and $0.50/M output. It scores 84.3 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 63.4 on DeepSWE v1.1, using hybrid KDA linear plus NoPE sparse MLA attention to cut attention compute ~3× and KV cache 4.4× versus GLM-5.3. The post Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash: A 320B-A18B Natively Multimodal MoE With a 1M-Token Context appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 智譜 發布了 GLM-5.3-Flash，這是 GLM-5 系列中首個原生多模態模型。該模型擁有 3,200 億總資料量和 180 億活動資料量，上下文視窗大小為 1,048,576 個 Token，權重採用 MIT 許可，API 定價為每百萬輸入 0.15 美元，每百萬輸出 0.50 美元。 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 測試中獲得 84.3 分，在 DeepSWE v1.1 測試中獲得 63.4 分。它採用混合 KDA 線性注意力機制和 NoPE 稀疏 MLA 注意力機制，相較於 GLM-5.3，注意力計算量降低了約 3 倍，鍵值快取降低了 4.4 倍。這篇文章《智譜 發布 GLM-5.3-Flash：一款擁有 100 萬個 Token 上下文的 320 億-180 億原生多模態模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。 Hugging Face

items_all_raw.title: Alibaba’s Qwen Team Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A 125B Multimodal MoE With 6B Active Parameters Previewing the Qwen4 Architecture
items_all_raw.summary: We look at Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Alibaba's open-weight multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model and an early preview of the Qwen4 architecture. We break down where the 180B parameters actually sit: a 125B backbone, a 51B N-gram embedding table, and a 4B multi-token prediction module, with only 6B active per token. We walk through the four architectural changes — the Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention hybrid, Gated Residual, N-gram Embedding, and the Muon optimizer. We also cover the benchmark results, the reported 1/9 training cost against Qwen3.7-Plus, and what self-hosting a 172.78 GiB FP8 checkpoint really demands. The post Alibaba’s Qwen Team Releases Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: A 125B Multimodal MoE With 6B Active Parameters Previewing the Qwen4 Architecture appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 本文將介紹 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、阿里巴巴的 開放權重多模態專家混合模型以及 Qwen4 架構的早期預覽版。我們將詳細分析 1800 億參數的實際分佈：一個 1250 億的骨幹網路、一個 510 億的 N-gram 嵌入表和一個 40 億的多標記預測模組，其中每個標記僅需 60 億個有效參數。我們將詳細介紹四項架構變更—閘控 DeltaNet 和 Qwen 稀疏注意力混合模型、門控殘差、N-gram 嵌入以及 Muon 優化器。此外，我們還將介紹基準測試結果、Qwen4 相對於 Qwen3.7-Plus 的 1/9 訓練成本，以及自架 172.78 GiB FP8 檢查點所需的實際資源。文章「阿里巴巴的 Qwen 團隊發布 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：一款具有 60 億個活動參數的 125B 多模 MoE，預覽 Qwen4 架構」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Orchestration is the new challenge for CX in the age of AI agents
items_all_raw.summary: Presented by Tata Communications Enterprises are deploying AI agents, voice AI, and automation across messaging, voice, and digital channels faster than the architecture meant to support it. Most of that deployment has involved attaching conversational AI to legacy systems never built for it, says Gaurav Anand, global head of the Customer Interaction Suite at Tata Communications. "In the rush to deploy AI, organizations have largely bolted conversational AI onto legacy systems," Anand says. "As a result, while many enterprises have adopted digital tools, very few have platforms that are truly integrated, scaled, and capable of seamless orchestration." That gap creates a heavy cognitive load for human agents who must piece together context across disjointed tools to understand what an AI system has already told a customer. The challenge is not simply access to data, but the absence of a shared enterprise context that connects customer identities, interactions, transactions, policies, journeys, and operational systems into a common understanding. Traditional CX architecture was built for linear, human-driven routing, not for managing real-time data flows between autonomous AI systems, data lakes, and human workers. "Today's operational complexity is no longer about adding more intelligence," he adds. "It is about coordinating the existing intelligence across the enterprise, so the enterprise customer never feels the friction of those internal silos. That requires a shared context layer that allows AI systems, applications, and people to operate from the same understanding of
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 塔塔通訊公司指出，企業在訊息、語音和數位管道部署人工智慧代理、語音人工智慧和自動化的速度已經超過了其架構本身的承載能力。塔塔通訊公司客戶互動套件全球負責人高拉夫·阿南德表示，大多數部署都是將對話式人工智慧附加到原本並未為此設計的舊系統上。 「在匆忙部署人工智慧的過程中，企業大多隻是將對話式人工智慧生硬地附加到舊系統上，」阿南德說道，「因此，儘管許多企業已經採用了數位化工具，但真正擁有整合、可擴充套件且能夠無縫協調的平臺的企業卻寥寥無幾。」這種差距給人工客服帶來了沉重的認知負擔，他們必須從分散的客戶中理解挑戰不僅在於資料訪問，還在於缺乏一個能夠將客戶身份、互動、交易、策略、旅程和營運系統連線起來的共享企業上下文。傳統的客戶體驗架構是為線性、人工驅動的路由而設計的，而不是為了管理自主人工智慧系統、資料湖和人工客服之間的即時資料流。他補充說：“如今的運營複雜性不再在於增加更多智慧，而在於協調企業內部現有的智慧，從而避免企業客戶感受到內部資訊孤島帶來的摩擦。這需要一個共享的上下文層，使人工智慧係統、應用程式和人員能夠基於相同的理解開展工作。”

items_all_raw.title: Bill Gates warns AI is more dangerous than the tech industry will admit
items_all_raw.summary: Bill Gates warns in an essay and an NYT interview about mass unemployment and easier bioterrorism through AI, and he accuses his own industry of deliberately hiding the risks. "It's bad for us, for the next trillion we're trying to raise." He rejects self-regulation and instead calls for institutions modeled on nuclear weapons control and a token tax on AI use. The article Bill Gates warns AI is more dangerous than the tech industry will admit appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 比爾蓋茲在一篇文章和接受《紐約時報》採訪時警告說，人工智慧可能導致大規模失業，並使生物恐怖主義更容易發生，他還指責科技業故意隱瞞這些風險。 「這對我們不利，不利於我們努力籌集的下一個萬億美元。」他反對自我監管，而是呼籲建立類似核武管制的機構，並對人工智慧的使用徵收象徵性稅。這篇文章《比爾蓋茲警告：人工智慧比科技業承認的更危險》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all_raw.title: IBM drops open-weight Granite 4.2 family with built-in agentic capabilities under Apache 2.0
items_all_raw.summary: IBM is releasing its Granite 4.2 language models in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes, trained on about 15 trillion tokens with a context window of up to 512,000 tokens. The larger models use "agentic RL" training to learn tool use and code execution on their own. All models are available under the Apache 2.0 license. The article IBM drops open-weight Granite 4.2 family with built-in agentic capabilities under Apache 2.0 appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: IBM 發布了其 Granite 4.2 語言模型，規模分別為 30 億、80 億和 300 億，這些模型使用約 15 兆個詞元進行訓練，上下文視窗最大可達 51.2 萬個詞元。規模較大的模型採用「智能體強化學習 (agentic RL)」訓練，能夠自主學習工具使用和程式碼執行。所有模型均以 Apache 2.0 授權發布。文章《IBM 發佈內建智慧體功能的開源 Granite 4.2 系列，採用 Apache 2.0 授權》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all_raw.title: Gartner示警AI可從既有資料推論敏感個人資訊，成隱私管理新風險
items_all_raw.summary: 商業與科技研究機構Gartner預測，到了2029年，多數隱私事件將不再源自個人識別資訊直接曝光，而是AI根據既有資料產生的個人資訊推論所引發的風險。即使資料本身看似無害，或已經過匿名化、彙整處理，AI仍可能綜合其中線索，推論出健康狀況、行為模式等敏感個人資訊。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Paul Dix
items_all_raw.summary: The fact that AI wrote 1M LOC and then refined it over the course of the next couple of months to produce a reliable piece of software that is currently running on millions of developer machines is absolutely mind blowing. And you can say, “well it’s not that impressive because they had an oracle to compare against, so it was simple to go from one language to another”, but I think that’s selling this entire thing short. If you can build a verification system and give proper direction, AI can produce a highly complex, highly sophisticated piece of software and it can continue to refine it until it just works. — Paul Dix , The end of programming Tags: coding-agents , ai-assisted-programming , generative-ai , bun , ai , llms

items_all_raw.title: 數發部將建立政府AI風險評估機制，未來政府大型AI服務上線前擬納入風險審查、10月公佈機關AI內控範本
items_all_raw.summary: 隨著「人工智慧基本法」在今年1月14日正式施行，推動政府數位轉型及AI治理的數發部已規畫建立政府機關的AI治理制度。數發部數位政府司長王誠明在今天(8/26)的數位政府高峰會中表示，政府AI應用已從試驗階段逐步進入制度化管理，未來將建立一套標準化的AI風險評估與內控制度，讓各機關在匯入生成式AI及AI代理（AI Agent）等新技術時，有一致的治理流程可遵循。 王誠明首先指出，近年生成式AI快速普及，許多公務人員已開始主動嘗試各種AI工具，政府當務之急是要建立「如何安全使用AI」的治理制度。他形容，目前AI發展就像高速公路剛開始有大量車輛上路，「良好的治理不是限制你的手腳，而是讓創新可以放心往前走」，他說。

items_all_raw.title: IBM Releases Granite 4.2: Bringing Native Reasoning and Agentic RL to Open Enterprise Models
items_all_raw.summary: IBM has released Granite 4.2, a family of open reasoning language models in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes, all under Apache 2.0. Every model exposes a thinking / low-effort / non-thinking switch and native tool calling. The 8B and 30B additionally go through an agentic RL block that trains them to edit code, drive a terminal, and run web searches inside real sandboxed environments. The 30B reports 57.00 on SWE-Bench Verified and 29.24 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. The post IBM Releases Granite 4.2: Bringing Native Reasoning and Agentic RL to Open Enterprise Models appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: IBM 發布了 Granite 4.2，這是一系列開放推理語言模型，包含 3B、8B 和 30B 三種規模，均採用 Apache 2.0 授權。每個模型都提供「思考/低投入/非思考」切換開關和原生工具呼叫。 8B 和 30B 模型也經過一個智慧強化學習模組，該模組訓練它們在真實的沙盒環境中編輯程式碼、操作終端和進行網路搜尋。 30B 模型在 SWE-Bench Verified 測試中獲得 57.00 分，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 測試中獲得 29.24 分。本文《IBM 發布 Granite 4.2：將原生推理與智慧強化學習引入開放企業模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。
